desc: Derive and verify the DP recurrence: for node value v, cost0/cost1 from children costs, taking sums of the two smallest costs for the target value.
Ideation: bottom-up level-by-level computation, O(3^N) memory, answer = root cost for opposite value.

Implement solution: parse input (concatenate tokens), init leaf cost arrays, iteratively combine groups of 3 (new_cost = sum - max), determine root's current value (the cost that is 0), print the other cost.
Validate against brute-force exhaustive flip search for small N (N≤3) on random and edge-case strings (all 0s, all 1s, alternating).
Confirm performance and memory for N=13 (3^13 ≈ 1.6M leaves; array('i') ≈ 19MB peak, ~800k combine iterations, well within limits).
